questions.question: When changing a Paseo UI feature, which two places must change together, and how is their equivalence checked?
questions.expected: Shared app source android/packages/app/src AND patches/paseo-<feature>.mjs with the same meaning; a root test (e.g. tests/usage-donut.test.mjs) compares them
questions.answer: Change the shared app source (android/packages/app/src/...) AND the web-bundle patch (patches/paseo-<feature>.mjs) with the same meaning. A root test checks that both sides match, e.g. tests/usage-donut.test.mjs runs donut-model.ts with types stripped and compares it to the patch output. Also wire into unwrap and apply order of scripts/patch-paseo-composer.mjs.

questions.question: scripts/package.py fails with 'Reviewed release source missing: docs/UPSTREAM.md'. Cause and fix?
questions.expected: A MANIFEST.sha256 path is missing from the working tree; restore it or remove the line and sync tests/package.test.mjs
questions.answer: Cause: a path listed in MANIFEST.sha256 is missing from the working tree, including deleted/moved docs such as docs/UPSTREAM.md. Fix: restore the file, or remove its line from MANIFEST.sha256 and keep the required list in tests/package.test.mjs in sync.

questions.question: How is the Android versionCode composed, and what must the new value be compared against?
questions.expected: androidVersionCode (from Paseo base version) + offset +N; above every existing release/install (dpkg -s paseodog, gh release list)
questions.answer: androidVersionCode, derived from the Paseo base version, plus a release offset +N. Raise N so the value is above every existing release and install, checked with dpkg -s paseodog and gh release list.

questions.question: Another session is mid-turn; may you postpone installing the new .deb until it ends? May you also install the APK on the user's phone?
questions.expected: No postponement: apply immediately (sudo dpkg -i, relaunch), report interrupted sessions. Phone install needs separate approval
questions.answer: No to the postponement: PC apply including sudo dpkg -i of the verified .deb and relaunch runs immediately, not deferred for other sessions; list interrupted sessions. No to the phone install: not covered by PC-apply approval, needs separate approval stating target and impact.
